name: iCon Group Ltd
summary: Based in Tel Aviv, Israel, iCon Group Ltd is an enterprise focused on the importation and distribution of Apple's diverse product lineup throughout the country. Their offerings span iconic devices such as the Apple Watch, iPad, iPhone, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, and AirPods, in addition to various accessories. The company disseminates these Apple goods to a wide array of clients, including significant retail chains, authorized distributors, independent dealers, mobile phone stores, and other commercial channels.
